# Paradise_nursey_shopping_application
import React, { useState } from "react";
import "./styles.css";

const products = [
  {
    id: 1,
    name: "Snake Plant",
    price: 20,
    img: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    name: "Aloe Vera",
    price: 15,
    img: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    name: "Cactus",
    price: 25,
    img: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  },
];

export default function App() {
  const [cart, setCart] = useState([]);

  const addToCart = (product) => {
    setCart((prevCart) => {
      const item = prevCart.find((p) => p.id === product.id);
      return item
        ? prevCart.map((p) =>
            p.id === product.id ? { ...p, quantity: p.quantity + 1 } : p
          )
        : [...prevCart, { ...product, quantity: 1 }];
    });
  };

  const updateQuantity = (id, amount) => {
    setCart((prevCart) =>
      prevCart
        .map((p) => (p.id === id ? { ...p, quantity: p.quantity + amount } : p))
        .filter((p) => p.quantity > 0)
    );
  };

  const removeFromCart = (id) => {
    setCart((prevCart) => prevCart.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
  };

  const totalItems = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
  const totalPrice = cart.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity,
    0
  );

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <header>
        <h1>🌿 Paradise Nursery</h1>
        <p> 🛒Cart ({totalItems})</p>
      </header>

      <h2>Our Houseplants</h2>
      <div className="products">
        {products.map((plant) => (
          <div key={plant.id} className="product">
            <img src={plant.img} alt={plant.name} />
            <h3>{plant.name}</h3>
            <p>${plant.price}</p>
            <button onClick={() => addToCart(plant)}>Add to Cart</button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <h2>Your Shopping Cart</h2>
      {cart.length === 0 ? (
        <p>Cart is empty.</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          {cart.map((item) => (
            <div key={item.id} className="cart-item">
              <h3>
                {item.name} - ${item.price}
              </h3>
              <p>
                Quantity:
                <button onClick={() => updateQuantity(item.id, -1)}>-</button>
                {item.quantity}
                <button onClick={() => updateQuantity(item.id, 1)}>+</button>
                <button onClick={() => removeFromCart(item.id)}>Remove</button>
              </p>
            </div>
          ))}
          <p>Total Price: ${totalPrice}</p>
          <button onClick={() => alert("Thank you for your purchase!")}>
            Checkout
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}body {
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
  background: url("https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcT7wqKEiqrI2fr4JdCZtyUjo5OvgQqCxfr2Og&s")
    no-repeat center center/cover;
  color: white;
}

header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px;
  background: rgba(0, 128, 0, 0.8);
  color: white;
}

.products {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.product,
.cart-item {
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  padding: 10px;
  width: 200px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  color: black;
}

button {
  padding: 5px 10px;
  margin-top: 5px;
  background: #007bff;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

button:hover {
  background: #0056b3;
}
